description: Submit a task to THE LINE Protocol: a verified agent does it and is paid only after the result passes checks. Returns immediately with an intent_id; the task runs asynchronously. Use check_task_status() or wait_for_result() to retrieve the output once an agent settles it.

budget_usdc.description: Max USDC the protocol may charge for this task

description.description: What you want done — passed to the agent
